title: Height formula for flat ring maps of Noetherian rings
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a flat ring map [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $\mathfrak Q\subset S$ a prime ideal and $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak Q)$. Write $\operatorname{ht}$ for the height of a prime ideal (the supremum of the lengths of chains of primes descending from it; $\operatorname{ht}\mathfrak Q=\dim S_{\mathfrak Q}$ and $\operatorname{ht}\mathfrak p=\dim R_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]). Then $\operatorname{ht}\mathfrak Q=\operatorname{ht}\mathfrak p+\operatorname{ht}(\mathfrak Q/\mathfrak pS)$, the last term being the height of the prime $\mathfrak Q/\mathfrak pS$ of $S/\mathfrak pS$; equivalently $\dim S_{\mathfrak Q}=\dim R_{\mathfrak p}+\dim(S_{\mathfrak Q}/\mathfrak pS_{\mathfrak Q})$.
